# DSH plugin market index
A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) **plugin market index** in format 1, listing the bundles published by @Sile
epSeek Harness) **plugin market index** in format 1, listing the bundles published by @Silentforfar.

[代码示例省略，未执行]
DSH ships no official market: a market is exactly this file, hosted anywhere over https. The **Disco
ver** tab of the Plugins page reads the index sources you add.
## Use it

1. Open **Plugins** in the DSH Web sidebar.
2. Select **More** next to **Experimental plugins** and

switch on **Custom plugin markets**. The page then shows **Installed** and **Discover**.
3. In **Dis

cover**, add the index URL above.
4. Install any listed bundle. DSH installs it into the current pro
file, pins the exact commit, and keeps the index source for later updates.
The Host caches a successful read for ten minutes and refuses redirects, so a release shows up after
the cache expires or after the index is re-read.
## What is listed
| Plugin | What it does |
| `@silentforfar/dsh-session-menu` | Session menu extras: export log, reveal workspace folder, mark

unread, permanent delete. |
| `@silentforfar/dsh-side-task` | Opens a temporary session in the right

sidebar, in the same workspace with its own context. |
| `@silentforfar/dsh-qq-screenshot` | Captur

es a screen region with QQ's screenshot tool and hands the image to the model. |
| `@silentforfar/ds
h-computer-use` | Windows desktop control: window screenshots, UI Automation trees, and real input a
r-use` | Windows desktop control: window screenshots, UI Automation trees, and real input actions. |
Every version is a `git` source pinned to a full 40-character commit, so an install is reproducible
and independent of any branch moving later. Nothing here is published to npm; installs come straight
from the plugin repositories.
## Maintainer notes
`index.json` is the published document. Each entry carries display metadata (title, description, ico
n, category, labels, keywords) and one or more pinned versions.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`npm run pin` expects the plugin repositories next to this one:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Release checklist:

1. In the plugin repository: bump `version` in `package.json`, commit, push.
2. Here: `npm run pin`,

which adds a version entry for the new number and refreshes the icons.
3. `npm run validate`, then
commit and push `index.json`.
A commit that changes code without a version bump is re-pinned in place, which existing installs do
**not** see as an update — bump the version when you want the change delivered.
## Format notes
- `title` and `description` are either a plain string or an object keyed by lowercase language id wi

th `en` required.
- `metadata.category` and every `metadata.labels` id must be declared in `metadata

.categories` / `metadata.labels`.
- `icon` must be an https URL or a base64 SVG/PNG/JPEG/WebP data U

RL of at most 32 KiB decoded.
- `publishTimestamp` is Unix seconds; versions of one plugin are order
ed by SemVer precedence, not by timestamp.
